Retail.intro: Search current eBay listings by exact part number or description. Choose a market and delivery country. Purchases are completed at the retailer; Capcar does not take payment.
Retail.savingNote: Searching and merchant checkout do not require a vehicle. Saving does not confirm fitment or place an order.

Retail.affiliate: Affiliate link: Capcar may earn a commission if you purchase.
Retail.direct: Direct retailer link. No Capcar affiliate campaign applied.
Retail.saved: Saved to this vehicle’s wishlist. Existing duplicates were kept unchanged.
Retail.saveError: Could not save this listing. Check your selected vehicle and browser storage.

Expansion.error: Could not load this. Please try again.
Expansion.viewerError: The 3D connection was blocked or timed out. Try allowing Sketchfab in your browser shields, then reopen the model.
Expansion.configNote: Make this reference your own: choose a surface, explore a tint and save your camera view. Changes stay on this device. Existing textures remain visible; this is a visual reference, not a parts-fitment simulation.
Expansion.noSaved: No saved configuration for this model on this device.
Expansion.fanModel: Community-made film reference. Capcar is not affiliated with the film studio or vehicle manufacturer.
Expansion.adapted: Interactive material tints may differ from the original.
Expansion.storageError: Browser storage is unavailable. Your saved items were not changed.
Expansion.boardFull: Keep up to 12 offers. Remove one before adding another.
Expansion.boardNote: Compare saved offers and set an item-price target. History records prices you see in live searches on this device. Targets update when the same offer appears again; there are no background notifications.
Expansion.boardEmpty: Add offers from the results above to compare them here.
Expansion.targetReached: Last observed price meets your target. Confirm the current price at eBay.
Expansion.handoffNote: One unit per offer. Subtotals use your last observed prices and keep currencies separate. Shipping may change for multiple items; taxes, availability, fitment, returns and the final amount are confirmed by eBay. Capcar does not place orders or take payment.
Expansion.confirmMerchant: I will confirm fitment, seller details, delivery, returns and the final total at the retailer.
Expansion.affiliate: Affiliate link: Capcar may earn a commission.
Expansion.listingCount: {count} matching listings in the current collection.
Expansion.photoError: Photo unavailable. Upload a JPEG, PNG or WebP under 8 MB and try again.
Expansion.photoReview: Photo saved. The listing will be reviewed again before publication.
Expansion.specialistsNote: Find enrolled workshops by service and area. Profiles are published by approved specialists. Approval confirms network access, not a guarantee of every repair; agree the work, price and terms directly with the shop.
Expansion.searchSpecialists: Search by workshop, service or area
Expansion.noSpecialists: No matching published profiles yet. The network is growing.
Expansion.profileNote: Approved specialists can publish their business name, town, website and the details below. Enter your complete current profile each time. Uncheck publication to hide it.
Expansion.publishConsent: Publish these details on Capcar’s public specialist directory.
